texts.preamble: Teli Ravi Prakash vs The State Of Telangana on 10 July, 2025 Author: N.Tukaramji Bench: N.Tukaramji The Honourable Sri Justice N.Tukaramji Criminal Petition No. 8520 Of 2025 Order
texts.facts: This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS, 2023') seeking quashment of the proceedings in FIR No.182 of 2025 on the file of the Yellandu Police Station, Bhadradri Kothagudem District, against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 2. 2. The petitioner are arrayed as accused Nos.1 and 2 in FIR No.182 of 2025 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 275 of BNS. 8. As per the prosecution, on 15.05.2025 at 13.00 hours, the complainant/head Constable lodged a complaint alleging that the petitioners were caught by the police while illegally transporting noxious food and the complainant and his staff apprehended the petitioners and seized tobacco products 1) Vimal Panmasala 15 packets 15 x 150 = Rs.2,250/-, 2) VI- Tobacco 15 packets 15 x 30 = Rs.450/-, 3) Teli Ravi Prakash vs The State Of Telangana on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93030894/ 1 HAI tobacco 5 packets 5 x 300 Rs.1500/-, 4) RR tobacco 2 packets 2 x 250 = Rs.500/-, 5) DNS tobacco 4 packets 4 x 300 = Rs.1200/-, total worth Rs.5,900/- under confessional and seizure panchanama. 9.
texts.arguments: The prosecution case in brief is that the petitioners/accused are involved in selling and purchasing the banned Tobacco products and the Police concerned has seized the said Tobacco products worth of Rs.5,900/- from the possession of the petitioners. 5. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that a Coordinate Bench of this Court vide Criminal Petition Nos.3731 and Batch on considering similar allegations and the merits [LEAKAGE_MASK] the 2 NTR,J proceedings against the petitioner therein. He further submits that the police have registered the present crime in violation of the orders passed by this Court. Hence, prayed for quashment of the proceedings against the petitioners. 6. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that the petitioners have been found with the Tobacco products and investigation is pending. However fairly admitted that in the authority cited by the petitioner in the similar circumstances, the proceedings against the petitioner therein were [LEAKAGE_MASK]. 10. Having regard to similar factual position, a Coordinate Bench of this Court in Crl.P.No.6235 of 2022 held that against the allegations of illegal sale and transportation of tobacco products the accusations under Sections 188, 269, 270, 272, 273, 278, 328 read with Sections 511, 336, 409 and 420 of I.P.C., cannot be maintained and [LEAKAGE_MASK] the proceedings against the petitioners therein.
